_notes: A2 hired workers (GAME_DESIGN 19.4). Each role is hired once on its price pad in the garage (hirePrice) and is paid wagePerDay at midnight every game day (a game day is 3 real minutes). speed = tiles per second, carry = stack size. Upgrades are bought at the Help Wanted board: speed +speed.pct per level, carry +carry.plus per level; the player's own carry upgrades are there too. Pilot: kiosk -> launch pads with tickets. Runner: launch pads -> render rigs with SD cards, rigs -> counter with deliverables (never the cloud uplink). Clerk: staffs the counter. Collector: picks up cash. pickupWaitSec (Oscar, before A3): after picking up less than a full stack, a worker waits up to this long for more before walking off (sooner if the stack fills).
